_note: What you see: One sale: lines, totals, payment, print or mail the receipt, register a return.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Eén verkoop: regels, totalen, betaling, bon printen of mailen, retour registreren.
Eén hoofdknop, die de status volgt: One primary button, following the status
, met Bon printen, Bon mailen en Retour: , with Print receipt, Email receipt and Register refund beside it
Bon printen, Bon mailen en Retour regist: Print receipt, Email receipt and Register refund, as above
Regels bewerken, Parkeren en Terugboeken: Edit lines, Park and Reverse; Reverse for admins only and always with a reason
Pin via de pinautomaat, sessie 7F3A-22: Card via the card terminal, session 7F3A-22
Een reden is verplicht om een betaling t: A reason is required to reverse a payment. Without one nothing is reversed; the reason goes into the tax audit trail.
